summary: Iter24 frontend-only review of 4 new advisor features. All 4 pass end-to-end against the live preview URL with real advisor login (MFA via shared TOTP). (1) Mark Reviewed: 4 today-review-<id> buttons rendered in advisor-today-panel; clicking first (client_0a836c02) showed 'Marked reviewed' toast, attention rows dropped 4→3, and after full reload the reviewed household stayed excluded (persisted). today-attention-open-<id> sub-area also present per spec. (2) Task Quick-Add: quick-add-client / quick-add-title / quick-add-submit all present. Submit correctly disabled when empty, still disabled with title-only, becomes enabled when both household (client_a1 Anh Nguyen) and title set. Submit triggered 'Task added' toast, cleared title input, and the new task 'Test task from testing' appeared on /tasks board. (3) Search Everywhere: household-search input lives above both tabs. On Opportunities tab, typing 'Nguyen' filtered opp rows to only Nguyen (Okafor+Rossi hidden); gibberish 'xyzzz9999notreal' showed the 'No matching opportunities' empty state. Switching back to Queue preserved the search and filtered household cards; gibberish rendered household-search-empty. (4) Digest Retry: triggered 'Send test' and 'Send weekly summary test' to generate failed entries; digest-history then contained 5 digest-retry-<entryId> buttons. Clicking first resend triggered expected bounce; 'not delivered' entries continued to grow — matches preview-env PASS criteria per task note. One console 401 observed pre-auth (expected AuthContext bootstrap before token injection), not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: No functional issues found this iter. Previous iter23 suggestion to add data-testid='queue-household-card-<id>' to each Queue card still stands — not blocking.
